summary: All 105 files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all seven computed claims reproduced. The public sources checked yielded no gene-level author result for the four day-8 DSS mice versus four controls, supporting confirmed_not_located. The corrected proposal limits the GEO claim to what the searches returned, removes the unsupported ranking of the Aberdeen paper as the closest match, and identifies the cited ENA record as a sequencing run. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: Author effect concordance, tested-gene coverage, P values and FDR remain unassessed until a gene-level result can be linked to the eight registered hypothalamus libraries.
